description: Land Title Settlement Department - Batangala, Dehiovita D/S Division, Kegalle District - Cad. Map No. 610535 (23/0883)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining title to specific land parcels (Nos. 1:32, 1:33, 1:34, 1:35, and 1:36) in Batangala village, including detailed parcel information, ownership details (all assigned to "The State"), and legal references to the cadastral mapping system. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
